source: PER-FRAME camera shift relative to the CAR from the windscreen/bonnet cowl edge (rows 1022-1080, phase correlation on gradient magnitude vs a fixed reference, +-4 frame median); 27 low-confidence frames (response<0.3 or >10 px off the local median) interpolated. yaw = -6.10 + dx/(f*pi/180); horizon = 463 + dy - median(dy). Validated by prediction-vs-outcome against the lane lines and by paint width. 2026-09-24
